brief:
The Guardian reported that the war in Gaza has exposed growing fractures across Europe, three years after Hamas attacks on October 7, 2023 triggered Israel's military response. The conflict has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, according to the outlet.

Support for Palestinian causes faces institutional punishment in some European settings, while scrutiny of Muslim communities has intensified among some Members of the European Parliament, the report indicates. The widening fault lines suggest the conflict's ripple effects continue reshaping European political alignments and debates.
dek: Solidarity with Palestine’s suffering is punished but MEPs allow a witch-hunt of European Muslims For three painful years, Israel’s genocidal war in Gaza, in retaliation for the Hamas terror attacks on 7 October 2023, has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians…
title: Gaza conflict deepens divisions within European institutions
